subject: Teacher Contract Negotiations and McGlynn Playground Design
overview: The Committee reviewed the $2.6 million design for an inclusive playground at McGlynn Elementary and received a major update on stalled contract negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association.

items.title: Rules Referral on Student Participation
items.summary: Referred the proposal to include student participation on school committee agendas to the Rules Subcommittee.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: Approved routine business including bills, payroll, and minutes from the November 21 meeting.

items.title: Superintendent's Report
items.summary: Reported on legislative mental health advocacy, holiday community gift programs, and upcoming flu clinics.

items.title: After-School Program Presentation
items.summary: Presented enrollment data showing waitlists at all four elementary schools and discussed staffing shortages and the new sliding-scale tuition model.

items.title: McGlynn Inclusive Playground Design
items.summary: Approved a $2.6 million design for an inclusive playground and voted to support a $750,000 ARPA funding request for the project.

items.title: Labor Relations Report
items.summary: Discussed the status of negotiations with the Medford Teachers Association following a failed ratification vote and a recent union declaration of no confidence.

items.title: Dyslexia Screening Report Request
items.summary: Requested a report on the district's dyslexia screening assessments and intervention data for grades K-2.
